scope: Owner-approved dedicated Stripe sandbox five-resource read verification in existing guarded Agent Operations API and Connections UI; no agent grants, provider mutations, paid execution or budget changes.
riskAnalysis: STRICT financial credential, identity and external-read boundary. Require fresh owner, Preview branch/release, exact provider sandbox account, shared Ops revocation/revision and sanitized first-page evidence. Preserve unchanged paid accounting and independently disabled internal-agent permissions.

threatModel.assets: Restricted sandbox credential, owner/workspace identity, immutable audit/evidence and customer confidentiality.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Authenticated Owner UI to existing Ops API/policy; shared Ops journal to bounded fixed Stripe GETs; provider response to PII-free receipt; Redis atomic evidence persistence.
threatModel.abuseCases: Wrong sandbox/live key, forged owner, caller URL/account substitution, raw PII leak, replay/concurrent request, late response after revoke, failed identity bypass.
threatModel.mitigations: Restricted test-key guard, exact account GET before five fixed reads, no Stripe-Account header, fresh owner/release/journal at each boundary, CAS one running verification, finite diagnostics and no writes or agent grants.

rollback: Remove/disable Stripe owner controls and revert only reviewed Preview delta; preserve Secret without printing or rotating it, existing Ops/financial journal, historical evidence, main and Production. Local revoke fails closed and does not claim provider key revocation.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Actual service/API/UI reject malformed envelopes, corrupt task records and fabricated authority; no hidden repairs.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact Preview source/release/origin and existing owner operations-journal revision bind each verification boundary; no specialist task authority is created.
negativePaths.concurrency: Atomic verification-record CAS admits one running owner read. Shared journal checks plus final readback prevent stale revoked health claims; no cross-record atomic transaction is claimed.
negativePaths.cancellation: Abort/deadline rejects subsequent GETs and late results. Existing Emergency Stop changes the operations journal, invalidating the captured revision before subsequent boundaries.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No worker is launched. Interrupted running admission remains blocked until explicit owner local revoke; it is never silently reset or retried. Already transmitted reads cannot be recalled.
negativePaths.api-outage: Redis read/CAS failures deny verification; uncertain admission remains conservatively running or failed, with no automatic retry or recovery of permissions.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Preview-only fresh session/member/workspace owner, worker/nonowner/CSRF/Production negatives and workspace-isolated journals.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Six fixed read-only Stripe GETs at most; no inference transport, financial mutation or reservation writer exists. Existing fifteen-dollar testing ledger and unresolved uncertainty remain unchanged.
negativePaths.partial-execution: A failed identity or resource check records only a finite phase/category and halts further GETs. Failed or revoked records never become agent grants or accepted engineering outcomes.

defects.rootCause: Failure mapping inherited Object.prototype names instead of finite own entries.
defects.detectionGap: Initial synthetic errors omitted constructor, toString and __proto__.
defects.regression: Inherited-name provider errors remain fixed transport diagnostics, validated before persistence.
defects.historicalPrevention: Unknown errors cannot introduce non-enum failure values into stored evidence.

defects.rootCause: Final receipt return used the initial journal instead of fresh provider-revocation state.
defects.detectionGap: Initial revocation checks covered transport boundaries but not a revoke racing final receipt CAS.
defects.regression: Actual operations.connectionsManage provider revoke injected at final store must return revoked and connected=false.
defects.historicalPrevention: A preserved receipt cannot falsely report current healthy authority after an observed revoke.

defects.rootCause: UI retained a previous verified Stripe card after a failed new verification.
defects.detectionGap: Initial UI tests began from unknown state rather than prior success.
defects.regression: Verify success followed by network failure clears current healthy card.
defects.historicalPrevention: Failed owner verification is displayed as unconfirmed without stale success.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing owner Ops API and provider-revocation journal; narrow verification record is evidence/admission only, not a parallel permission system.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing owner-saved Hidden Secret exclusively Preview feature branch; actual /v1/account identity scope may require owner-approved minimum extra read after genuine denial.
proactiveReview.threats: Cross-workspace access, sandbox substitution, PII/credential exposure, indirect prompt injection, stale source and cancellation races.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Identity denial prevents all five list requests; unknown totals remain unknown; running or revoked state cannot silently retry or restore authority.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Provider boundary substitutes only; real verifier/API/UI exercised for owner denial, GET-only, revocation, CAS races, cancellation, malformed/live responses and secret stripping.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent QA and Auditor review required before publication, hosted real read remains separately evidenced; no claim of provider permission introspection.
proactiveReview.recovery: Owner local revoke; no automatic retry, key rotation, provider mutations or restore capability.
proactiveReview.readiness: Targeted core/UI pass; source-bound API positive awaits final fingerprint; full STRICT, Redis, CI, CodeQL and hosted verification pending root orchestration.
